stream_sentences.text: Solar wind parameters reflected the influence from a negative polarity CH HSS.
The solar wind environment is expected to remain enhanced as CH HSS influences continued over 07-09 Nov.
The geomagnetic field is likely to reach G1 (Minor) geomagnetic storm levels, with a chance for G2 (Moderate) storm levels, on 07-09 Nov due to anticipated influence from a negative polarity CH HSS.
